subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should OpenClaw make after-compaction hook session reset a public plugin contract, and if so should it support the legacy explicit-key overload in addition to the current-session reason-only form?
rationale: This choice creates a shipped plugin API and determines which lifecycle owners must guarantee reset-commit reconciliation; tests cannot decide the permanent compatibility contract.

options.title: Narrow current-session API
options.body: Expose only an after-compaction current-session reset contract, retain the legacy overload only if a shipped consumer requires it, and require complete caller reconciliation before merge.

options.title: Internal owner primitive only
options.body: Keep reset requests internal to bundled lifecycle owners and do not expose a public hook API until a smaller plugin contract is designed.

options.title: Pause the proposal
options.body: Close or pause this branch and reopen the direction through a focused API issue before carrying the broad lifecycle patch further.

recommendation.title: Narrow current-session API
recommendation.body: Expose only an after-compaction current-session reset contract, retain the legacy overload only if a shipped consumer requires it, and require complete caller reconciliation before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most directly connects this contributor to the gateway reset lifecycle and session finalization boundary.
